collector_behavior.process_result_problem: A successful exit with any stderr bytes is classified PROCESS_STDERR_NONEMPTY.
collector_behavior.git_ok: Rejects any stderr bytes before validating split stdout.

finding: The exact local split command exits successfully and returns the pinned split object, while Git subtree emits its 3,804-record progress meter on stderr. The collector currently treats those progress bytes as a process failure. The Plan121 live receipt does not retain its stderr, so this reproduction explains the diagnostic mechanism but does not claim the live stderr contents were preserved.
next_repair_boundary: Classify only the exact Git subtree progress format as harmless, retain fail-closed handling for other stderr, and preserve the existing exact stdout object/tree checks before permitting one separately authorized fresh read.
